tagline.en: Activity history, smarter notifications, rounds you never lose.
tagline.id: Riwayat aktivitas, notifikasi lebih rapi, ronde tidak pernah hilang.

items.en: Activity on the History page: games, rewards, AC/AG, Loyalty XP and sign-ins from the last 90 days.
items.id: Aktivitas di halaman Riwayat: game, hadiah, AC/AG, Loyalty XP, dan login 90 hari terakhir.

items.en: Unfinished Crash, Mines or Blackjack round? A bar takes you straight back to it.
items.id: Ada ronde Crash, Mines, atau Blackjack yang belum selesai? Ada bar untuk langsung balik ke sana.

items.en: Notifications get a System tab and unread counts on every filter.
items.id: Notifikasi punya tab Sistem dan jumlah belum dibaca di tiap filter.

items.en: Music and sounds start more reliably on phones and tablets.
items.id: Musik dan suara lebih mudah jalan di HP dan tablet.

items.en: Jam Gacor events: during an event every win pays an extra bonus.
items.id: Event Jam Gacor: selama event, setiap menang dapat bonus tambahan.

items.en: Bans, kicks and mutes by staff now show in chat.
items.id: Ban, kick, dan mute dari staf sekarang muncul di chat.

items.en: Announcements no longer stay on screen forever.
